input: Teach my kids to ride bikes

gold.taskTitle: Teach My Kids to Ride Bikes
gold.taskDescription: Help the kids learn to ride bicycles independently through a structured teaching process.

questions.title: How many kids are you teaching to ride?
questions.description: Understand the number of children involved so the plan accounts for each one.

questions.title: How old is each child you are teaching?
questions.description: Age helps determine the right approach, bike size, and realistic expectations for learning speed.

questions.title: Have any of them tried riding a bike before?
questions.description: Knowing their prior experience helps set the starting point of the teaching plan.

questions.title: Do the kids already have bikes that fit them?
questions.description: Confirms whether acquiring or sizing a bike is a necessary first step.

questions.title: Do you have safety gear like helmets and knee pads?
questions.description: Identifies whether protective equipment needs to be sourced before starting.

questions.title: Where do you plan to practice — driveway, park, or street?
questions.description: The location affects the type of surface, space available, and safety considerations.

questions.title: By when do you want them riding independently?
questions.description: A target date or timeframe helps structure how many sessions are needed and how frequently to practice.
